type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : geometric_tangent_space a)
  (f g :

      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ ↑⊤),
  (fderiv ℝ (⇑(f * g)) a) v = f a * (fderiv ℝ (⇑g) a) v + g a * (fderiv ℝ (⇑f) a) v

      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ ↑⊤),

name: directional_point_derivation_leibniz
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : geometric_tangent_space a)
  (f g :
    ContMDiffMap (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ)
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ ↑⊤),

  (w₁ w₂ : PointDerivation (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) a),
  ∑ i, (w₁ + w₂) (coordinate_cont_mdiff_map i) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i =
    ∑ i, w₁ (coordinate_cont_mdiff_map i) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i +
      ∑ i, w₂ (coordinate_cont_mdiff_map i) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i

name: point_derivation_to_geometric_map_smul_formula

∀ {n : ℕ} (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
  (w : PointDerivation (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) a),
  ∑ i, (c • w) (coordinate_cont_mdiff_map i) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i =
    c • ∑ i, w (coordinate_cont_mdiff_map i) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i

          (w.ofLp 0 < 0 →

  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type uM} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] (p : M) (v : TangentSpace I p) {J : Set ℝ} (η : ℝ → E),
  0 ∈ J →
    UniqueMDiffWithinAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) J 0 →
      η 0 = ↑(extChartAt I p) p →
        Set.MapsTo η J (extChartAt I p).target →
          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) η J →
            curve_velocityWithin (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) η J 0 = (mfderiv% ↑(extChartAt I p) p) v →
              have γ := ↑(extChartAt I p).symm ∘ η;
              ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) I (↑⊤) γ J ∧
                ∃ (hγ : γ 0 = p), hγ ▸ curve_velocityWithin I γ J 0 = v
